excerpts.text: The Escape and Plasma Acceleration and Dynamics Explorers, or [ESCAPADE](https://science.nasa.gov/mission/escapade/), will use two identical spacecraft to investigate how the solar wind interacts with Mars’ magnetic environment and how this interaction drives the planet’s atmospheric escape.
The ESCAPADE mission is being carried into orbit on the second launch of Blue Origin’s New Glenn rocket (NG-2) and is scheduled to launch in November 2025 from Cape Canaveral, Florida.
